title: Cute and cozy room in Nashville + a work space
description:
Kick back and relax in this calm, stylish home. Relax in the backyard and enjoy the night stars or sunshine and bird songs during the day. The room has a designated work space perfect for business travel or students.

The space
Welcome to your fully furnished, designer decorated home. It's cozy, beautiful and centrally-located. There’s a hospital, grocery store and shopping areas down the street. The house is a 10 minute drive to the hot spots in East Nashville & Germantown & 15 minutes to downtown Nashville. Relax in the quiet tree filled backyard which sits on top a hill and gaze at the stars or listen to the birds singing during the day.

Guest access
There’s a keypad for digital access. You will receive a 4 digit code when you book. Please be sure to press the lock button when leaving and the door will automatically lock

Other things to note
This home is a non-smoking, no drugs and no parties home. Only approved guests are allowed on the property.
